sections.heading: See it. Tap it. Settle in.

text: See it. Tap it. Settle in.
Follow the numbers to find your way around the Android app. Tap a screenshot to enlarge it. These are existing screenshots from an earlier build; they may show the former MovieAPP name.
Find a movie and open its details.
Tap Search titles and enter part of the name.
Choose a genre chip to narrow the list.
Tap the small i button on a poster for its details.
Find a TV show.
Tap TV in the bottom navigation.
Use Search shows to find a series.
Find the Cast button.
Look for the screen with waves icon in the top bar. Keep your phone and supported TV on the same Wi-Fi.
Tap it in your app, then select your TV when the device list appears. The list itself is not shown here.
Save a title, then find your downloads.
Tap the down-arrow on a title to start its download.
Open Downloads along the bottom. Wait until downloading finishes before leaving Wi-Fi.

sections.heading: Carry on where you left off

text: Carry on where you left off.
Open Continue in the bottom navigation.
Tap the play triangle beside a title to resume.
Use Continue or All history at the top to change the list.
Let Beebo pick something to watch.
Choose Movies, TV Shows or Both.
Set a category and year, or leave them on Any.
Tap Start surfing.
